requests: In Lantern, accept valid signed sessions addressed to at least one of alpha and beta; reject missing or unrelated audiences.
In Harbor, accept valid signed sessions only when both alpha and beta audiences are present; reject missing or partial audience sets.
In Moss, require expiration for signed sessions; accept future expiry even without not-before, and reject missing, past, or current expiry.
In Cove, allow omitted not-before; accept signed sessions when expiry exceeds now minus two seconds and any present not-before is at most now plus two seconds.
captions: Validate RS256 sessions with two seconds of tolerance for time comparisons.
Validate RS256 sessions and check whether issued-at is in the future.
Validate RS256 sessions and require the expiration claim to be present.
Validate RS256 sessions and require the not-before claim to be present.
Validate RS256 sessions and require at least one expected audience, alpha or beta.
Validate RS256 sessions and require both expected audiences, alpha and beta.
Validate RS256 sessions and require the expected issuer, issuer-A.
Validate RS256 sessions and require the expected subject, user-A.
